title: Mulan, the brave girl.
lines: Long ago, in the big country of China, lived a girl called Mulan.
Mulan lived with her father, her mother and her grandmother in a house with a beautiful garden.
There were blossom trees and a pond with fish.
Mulan was different from the other girls.
She was wild and clever and she loved jumping on her horse.
She always did everything a little bit differently from how it was supposed to be done.
One day Mulan had to go to the matchmaker.
She was a strict lady who had to decide whether Mulan could become a good bride.
Mulan was made pretty.
With a beautiful dress, white powder on her face and red lips.
But everything went wrong.
She spilled tea.
A cricket jumped into the lady's dress.
And in the end the lady's dress even caught fire!
You will never be a good bride!
shouted the lady.
Mulan was sad.
She looked at her reflection in the pond.
Who am I really?
she thought.
Then bad news came.
A big army of Huns was invading China.
The emperor called on all the men to fight.
One man from every family had to go.
From Mulan's family, her father had to go.
But her father was old.
He had a bad leg.
He walked with a stick.
Mulan knew he wasn't strong enough.
That night, while everyone was asleep, Mulan did something very brave.
She cut off her long hair with her father's sword.
She put on her father's clothes.
And she took his armour.
She jumped on her horse and rode away in the rain.
She went in her father's place.
As a boy.
Because girls weren't allowed in the army.
Mulan's ancestors saw it.
They sent a protector with her.
A little red dragon.
His name was Mushu.
Mushu wasn't as big as he thought he was.
He was as small as a lizard.
But he talked a lot and he was very funny.
And Mulan also got a lucky charm.
A little cricket, Cri-Kee.
In the army camp Mulan called herself Ping.
The other soldiers thought she was a boy.
The captain's name was Shang.
He was strict.
The training was very hard.
At first Mulan couldn't do anything.
She wasn't very good at fighting.
She couldn't carry the heavy stones.
But she didn't give up.
Every day she practised a little more.
One day the soldiers had to climb a pole.
A tall pole, with two heavy weights on their wrists.
Nobody could do it.
But Mulan thought hard.
She tied the two weights together and used them to grip the pole.
And that's how she climbed all the way to the top!
Everyone watched with their mouths open.
Then the Huns came.
There were lots and lots of them.
On horses, with swords, over the snowy mountains.
Mulan's army was much smaller.
But Mulan saw a big mountain with lots of snow on it.
She took a firework rocket.
She fired it at the top of the mountain.
Boom!
And the snow began to slide.
An enormous avalanche rolled down.
Straight at the Huns.
The Huns were buried under the snow.
Mulan had saved the army!
But Mulan was hurt.
And when the doctor looked after her, they discovered her secret.
Ping was a girl!
The soldiers were angry.
Shang left her behind in the snow.
But Mulan didn't give up.
She discovered that the leader of the Huns was still alive.
He wanted to attack the emperor in the city.
Mulan rode as fast as she could to the emperor.
She saved the emperor, together with her friends.
She even dressed her friends up as ladies, so they could get into the palace!
The emperor bowed to Mulan.
Everyone bowed to her.
The whole country cheered.
The emperor gave her the sword of the leader of the Huns.
To show her father what she had done.
Mulan went back home.
She knelt in front of her father.
She gave him the sword.
But her father dropped the sword.
He took Mulan in his arms.
The greatest gift, he said, is having you as my daughter.
The end.
